channel.title: Live: Match of the Day
channel.desc: Hull City look to kick off the FA Cup fourth round with an upset when they host Chelsea, with Liam Rosenior taking his new team back to the one he used to manage. Hull reached the FA Cup final in 2014 and have been riding high in the Championship under Sergej Jakirovic, but it will take a monumental effort to topple the eight-time FA Cup winners, whose expensively assembled squad have already reached the knockout rounds of the Champions League and the latter stages of the EFL Cup.
